description: This file contains functions for loading and retrieving user data related to bookings, including dynamic user loading, user lookup by username, and handling user routing within a booking system.

methods.name: loadUsers
methods.description: Main function to load users based on event type, dynamic list, and routing info, with error handling.

methods.name: loadUsersByEventType
methods.description: Loads users associated with a specific event type, normalizing hosts and matching users.

methods.name: loadDynamicUsers
methods.description: Loads users dynamically based on a list of usernames, ordered to match input list.

methods.name: findUsersByUsername
methods.description: Finds users in the database by username list, including related credentials and profiles.
